what: 01083 part (1) done by integrate, with one change: blaze-wasm-pack moved from crates/blaze-wasm/pack to crates/blaze-wasm-pack, a root member (crates/*), so its tests (src/tests.rs) run with the workspace's; as a path dependency under the excluded crates/blaze-wasm they would never have run. Its manifest now uses workspace = true dependencies and [lints] workspace = true. Root [workspace.dependencies] gained blaze-wasm-pack = { path = "crates/blaze-wasm-pack" }; Cargo.lock gained its [[package]] block and the line in blaze-cargo's list; blaze-cargo uses blaze-wasm-pack.workspace = true; crates/blaze-wasm/Cargo.toml points at ../blaze-wasm-pack (01069's build of blaze-wasm: the pack tests are now in the root workspace, not --manifest-path crates/blaze-wasm/pack). Workspace lints may add warnings in it. 01083 part (2), the check, is still yours; errors go to integrate-load (its successor window has closed, so send them to integrate). docs/cargo.md and crates.md updated.
